Keen fingers of mist trail from an elegantly curved blade. The hilt clutches a fathomless sapphire

Bonus. +2 greatsword. +4 vs giants.

Benefit. Detects enemies within far.

Personality. Neutral. Intelligent. Laments a bygone age of grandeur, harbours contempt for boors. Perplexed by the “new” races of elves, dwarves and men.

A steel shaft that smells of ozone and tingles to the touch

Benefit. Becomes a lightning bolt when thrown. All creatures in its path must pass a [[request 15 DEX]] check or take [[/roll 5d6]] damage. Destroys javelin.

A clay jar holding a stew of green, leafy sludge

@UUID[Item.g4NnCj52jIdjNbsE]{Spell Effect: Giant's Strength}

A wooden flask holds a bitter brown syrup that grows fat, lazy bubbles.

Curse. If a hill giant drinks this liquid they become highly agreeable,

treating all as friends for [[/roll 1d8]] days.

It stops being agreeable to anyone trying to hurt it and knows it was enchanted after the effect ends.

A small vial containing a clear, odorless liquid that belies its peril.

Curse. Drinking this liquid causes the imbiber to suffer 30 damage.

A turquoise brine with flecks of kelp.

Benefit. A creature that drinks this can breath in water for 1 hour.

@UUID[Item.nFL4TFx0l0bP7Q0S]{Spell Effect: Water Breathing}

Red embers drift from a blade engraved with flames. Gemstones encrust the hilt like barnacles.

Bonus. +2 shortsword.

Benefit. Once per day, ignites for 5 rounds, deals 1d4 extra damage.

Benefit. Detects gems within a near distance. The matching type on the hilt will glow in proportion to the quantity nearby.

Personality. Neutral. Insists wealth is a sign of virtue. Becomes passive aggressive to bearer if they leave gems behind.

Blue embers smelling of incense trail from an ornate blade. The iron hilt depicts thorny vines twisted over broken skulls.

Bonus. +2 longsword. +4 vs undead.

Benefit. Once per day, ignites for 5 rounds, deals 1d4 extra damage.

Curse. Attracts all undead within a far distance.

Personality. Lawful. Overconfident. Proclaims itself to be saviour of the world. Considers retreat a moral failing.

Icy metal wrought into a scarab. It pulses with a purplish-green light.

Benefit. Presenting this amulet and speaking its command word forces viewers within near to pass a [[request 15 WIS]] check or become insane for [[/roll 1d4+8]] rounds.

While insane, targets can’t take actions, and move in a random direction on their turns.

The amulet has [[/r 1d8+8]] charges.

Each use expends a charge.
Benefit. Your Strength becomes 18 (+4) and you deal x2 damage on melee attacks for 10 rounds
Benefit. Can breathe in water for 1 hour.

A heavy chain of shimmering black metal that chills the air around it.

Benefit. When made into a figure 8, 6 creatures within will teleport to an attuned location, so long as one holds a map of the destination.

text.content:
Based on the adventure

Steading of the Hill Giant Chief

by Gary Gygax

Adapted to Shadowdark

by Ryan Wheeler

Design: Gary Gygax, Ryan Wheeler

Artwork: Ricardo de Gaspar, Carlos Castilho

Editing: Ryan Wheeler

Layout Template: Sersa Victory

Foundry Implementation: John K. Watson

Troglodyte stats and description thanks to the Unnatural Selection sourcebook from http://dungeondamsel.com/

The Steading Crashers is an independent product published under the Shadowdark RPG Third-Party License and is not affiliated with The Arcane Library, LLC. Shadowdark RPG © 2023 The Arcane Library, LLC

BACKGROUND

Giants are raiding the lands of men! Death and destruction have been laid heavily upon every place these monsters have visited.

This has caused great anger in high places, and there is a call for heroes to punish the miscreant giants, or else return and put their heads upon the headsman's block!

Yet this charge is not as harsh as it may seem, for all have been fully equipped for the mission. Guides are available to help, and sport a splendid map showing exactly where the hill giant chief’s great timber fortress resides.

Furthermore, the party has been instructed to keep any and all loot they chance upon as a reward for the perils they are to face.

ROOM KEYS

The key-worded descriptions at the start of each location are safe to share with the players.

The bulleted details beneath are for the GM.

FACTIONS

Nosnra’s Band. A war band of hill giants, ogres and bugbears that follow their chief Nosnra because his cunning leads to many feasts.

Emissaries. Cloud, stone and fire giants working with Nosnra to plan future raids and support his band. Stone giants expand the dungeon and fire giants forge arms. The “higher” giants grate under the orders of Nosnra and his boorish hill giant kin, but are kept in line by Kelnam, the cloud giant.

Orc Rebels. Former slaves of Nosnra who have fled into the natural caves of the dungeon and gather arms and numbers. Follow their hateful chieftain Azuk. Wish to liberate the rest of the clan and escape.

BASE CAMP

At dusk the party arrives at a small, concealed cave near the giants' stronghold.

The cave provides relative safety provided the party avoids being followed or leaving a plain trail. There are sufficient supplies for several weeks' stay.

STEADING

Nosnra’s huge, windowless timber stronghold. It resides in a nasty area of hard rainfalls and wet fogs. Much of the clan revels in the main hall, while maids and slaves feed them and stragglers sleep off their drunk.

DUNGEON

A stone warren long predating the Steading. A deranged hill giant called The Keeper leads bugbears in watching over slaves and battling rebel orcs, while giants excavate new areas and forge weapons.

ENTRANCES

Main Gate. Area 1. Very heavy doors.

Watchtower. Area 1A. 40’ climb.

Compound. Area 22. Visible from elevation. Gates to north and east. Filled with dire wolves.

Chimneys. 20’ climb onto roof and down to hearths. All are burning.

@UUID[RollTable.ijkkokRjinqJ7fsK]{RUMORS}

ORDER OF BATTLE

  • Hill giants or ogres alerted will rush to ring the bell in Area 1A.

  • The bell raises the alarm throughout the steading level.

  • Hill giants and ogres in Area 11 arm themselves in Areas 12 & 13, then split into groups and sweep the Steading for 1 hour.

  • Giant in Area 19 gathers 2 ogres & 10 dire wolves from Areas 21 & 22. They split up into 2 groups and patrol outside perimeter.

  • Search parties bellow upon finding intruders and try to pin them down.

Ambush. The giants lay traps and ambushes against repeated raids.

Capture. Defeated intruders are kept in Area 28 to be cooked later.

Arson. If the Steading is somehow set aflame, all feasters from Area 11 escape to Areas 52 & 53. All treasure on the Steading level is destroyed.

Search Parties

FEATURES

Walls. Damp, 3' thick logs. Very unlikely to burn. Hung with hides.

Doors. Iron-bound 1’ thick logs. 7’ wide and 6' high. Heavy.

Floors. Stone matted with hides.

Ceiling. Great blackened rafters. 16‘ high at edges, 32' high at center.

ENCOUNTERS

Danger varies within the steading.

  • Areas 12-25 are deadly (check every round). +0 to encounter table result. @UUID[Macro.zWdstKuMvBCnV5hm]{Roll Steading Deadly Encounter}

  • Areas 1 & 11 are risky (check every 2 rounds). +3 to encounter table result. @UUID[Macro.CsZ11UfWEwCYfyWy]{Roll Steading Risky Encounter}

  • Areas 2-10 are unsafe (check every 3 rounds). +7 to encounter table result. @UUID[Macro.TrgldEkAhTFzAGCu]{Roll Steading Unsafe Enounter}

Cloaks and bags hang from pegs. 2 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{giants} snore beside an empty keg. More snores echo from some stairs.

  • Bags. 22 bags. Roll on the @UUID[RollTable.oRk2jhezg2rFbbR3]{Giant’s Bag} table for contents.

  • Giants. Sound asleep. If woken alert @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{giant} upstairs (Area 1A).

A giant nursing an empty flagon dozes beneath a bell.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{Giant}. If alerted, rings the bell. Wears a @UUID[Item.JpCip2Biv5CE7WOZ]{gemmed belt} (140 gp).

  • Bell. Alerts entire Steading.

A bear pelt hangs by some shelves. A chest sits in a corner. A fur-laden bed creaks under a dozing @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{giantess}.

  • Shelves. 9’ above the floor. Contain: @UUID[Item.ctJqJqyYxvHdSIbN]{Silver comb} (30 gp), @UUID[Item.qhMbanow6dZlhE8I]{Copper Mirror} (20 gp), @UUID[Item.EozDwyFqCj0Pz5Kb]{Pearled gold hairpin} (80 gp)

  • Chest. Contains 98 cp, 32 sp and 150 gp.

  • Giantess. 1:4 chance of waking [[/roll 1d4]], or wakes if loud noise occurs.

Meaty smacks and laughter precede 12 rollicking young giants.

  • @UUID[Actor.iyWCFJCAnBq5zCOF]{Young Giants}. Use @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.VrYTiPjDOH1LIEBr]{ogre} stats. Loudly playing with weapons. Noise from the room is assumed to be this.

    • Garb fits humans. Works to disguise as one of “the kids”. Fails within 20’ distance.

Torches dimly light ten sets of beds and chests. Clothes hang all along the walls. In two of the beds are snoring @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{giants}.

  • Chests. First holds 11 pp (worth 110 gp).

Four beds flank humble furnishings. Four giantesses in crabby aprons bicker while resting their feet.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{Giantess} maids. Lead by nasty old matron (34 HP), who is inclined to fight. If matron is slain others seek peace.

    • Describe Areas 8-10, and a safe path in exchange for matron's jewelry.

  • Beds. Under matron’s bed is chest with: 3x 250 gp @UUID[Item.cq78ps88baY09eC6]{bracelets}, 300 gp and 4 potions (2x @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.magic-items.Item.jucTGEjsqJ1znHdf]{Healing}, @UUID[Item.x7HeQzeiTlbraE8X]{Poison}, @UUID[Item.E8Y4EWL0yDrHqJ6Y]{Hill Giant Control})

A fireplace lights a hall adorned in hides and littered with kegs. Several seats rest under two huge tables, which hold pottery, flagons and platters.

Shields and weapons hang on the walls and above them–under-lit by the firelight–are the mounted heads of dwarves and men.

  • Fireplace. Mantle holds a brass jar (worthless) and a skull containing a @UUID[Item.qKijH592wtvk28M8]{ruby} (200 gp) hidden by a youth.

  • Shields. 8 total, 1 is a @UUID[Item.5K21R8sFVwwvTa8J]{+3 shield}.

A huge bed dominates a room richly dressed in furs and rugs. There is a strong animal odor.

Two chests and a coffer sit by a table and two chairs.

  • Animal odor. From the wife’s pet brown bear. Ambushes intruders (smells them coming).

  • Chests. Contain clothing.

  • Bed. Hides a pouch with gems:

    • @UUID[Item.3Pa2MrmC4Bz1wuni]{giant sapphire} (500 gp),

    • 3x @UUID[Item.uxTSjDOjhwTIk5F2]{emeralds} (100 gp),

    • 4x @UUID[Item.gg5u3h9JtOIisalt]{pearls} (50 gp),

    • 5x @UUID[Item.pdJupkvOCUKMH0Bm]{agates} (15 gp),

    • 3x @UUID[Item.XzGz2ZHaoQhx8gov]{malachite} (15gp),

    • 7x @UUID[Item.F5v2abY8LJVpu0xl]{quartz} (5 gp)

There is a bed, 2 chairs and a small table with a tun that reeks of cheap wine. Clothing hangs on pegs and beside them a thick chain is set into the wall.

An old shield and some weapons sit in a corner beside a chest.

  • Chest. Contains clothing.

  • Chain. For pet brown bear.

Trophies of monstrous creatures line the walls, along with fine armaments and 4 huge fur capes.

Three simple spears and a club lean over a weather-beaten cloak thrown against a wall. Under the cloak is a old rag.

  • Armaments. Two dozen items of the chief’s personal gear.

  • Capes. Worthless, except for one@UUID[Item.5zOXqZPTYbcCxT8J]{ giant otter fur} (200 gp).

  • Rag. Holds 5 @UUID[Item.lIdXQnttBsGaAcg7]{Lightning Javelins}.

A long table and seating is littered with mugs and scraps. Hides of great beasts line the walls. A map hangs opposite a fireplace.

  • Hides. A manticore hide conceals a door to Area 10A.

  • Map. On skin. Of the region, shows past and planned raids.

A stack of logs chokes an alcove. Beside it descend shadowy stairs.

  • Logs. Conceal 7 scroll tubes. A sealed one holds orders for next raid (in giantish) signed "Eclavdra” and plans for the Steading (minus Dungeon).

  • Stairs. Lead to Area 55.

Scant torches barely illuminate the walls of a 80’ long passage. Beyond, a great hall hosts trestle tables packed with reveling giants and ogres.

Barrels and tuns pungent with ale stand about, and a great fire pit roars in the center, roasting half a dozen men and orcs.

At the center of a high table sit two bejeweled giants. A gruff giant sits at their right hand and in seats of honor are a four larger giants of stony complexion and ornate dress.

A small ballista hangs on the wall directly behind them.

  • Reveling giants. See Feast Occupants table for details. Singing, laughing, arguing. Mask outside sounds.

  • Trestle tables. Full of various sorts of meat, cheese, bread, and drinking horns.

  • Ballista. Chief’s crossbow. (Near range, +4 bonus vs. large-sized). Shoots spears (2d6 damage, 6 nearby).

  • Servants and orc slaves enter the Great Hall from the west.

Feast Occupants

Occupant

Details

Quarters

Chief Nosra and wife (use @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.Om5RbAEQDbXI8MwN]{Frost Giant} and @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{Hill Giant})

Both wear 4 pieces of @UUID[Item.twM0kBcrIOmEDd8P]{jewelry}, each worth 1d8 x 100 gp.

Areas 8 & 7

Sub-chief (@UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{Hill Giant}, 49 HP)

Wears 4 pieces of @UUID[Item.twM0kBcrIOmEDd8P]{jewelry}, each worth 1d6 x 20 gp.

Area 2

Kelnam (@UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.vdCzdpAsjmYTa1ps]{Cloud Giant})

Area 14

3 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.zIaJgXifG1mIY7FM]{Stone Giants}

Area 14

24 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{Hill Giants}

Each giant wears 1d4 pieces of @UUID[Item.twM0kBcrIOmEDd8P]{jewelry} worth 1d6 x 20 gp each.

Areas 4, 15 & 16

8 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.VrYTiPjDOH1LIEBr]{Ogres}

Each ogre wears 1d2 pieces of @UUID[Item.twM0kBcrIOmEDd8P]{jewelry} worth 1d2+1 x 20 gp each.

Area 21

@UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.RG84tprafQTDEFCa]{Brown bear}

Beneath chief’s table. Has @UUID[Item.9CxEgThPOMof9NBe]{quartz studded collar} (100 gp).

@UUID[.6MwCQtf4cKy202nJ]{Area 8}

There are 30 helmets, 26 shields. 22 spears, 9 clubs, and 3 great axes

around the place.

  • Items fit bugbears and ogres.

Giant spears, shields, clubs, and axes are abundant here—no fewer than 12 of each.

There are 4 great swords, 2 huge iron maces, and a sheaf of 6' long spears.

  • Spears. Giants use as javelins.

  • Shields. Leaned against the walls. Behind the 7th one checked is a @UUID[Item.BJmE3QX94i7VKBF7]{+2 Warhammer}.

  • A @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.gear.Item.z98LNu4yOIe1B1eg]{warhammer} out of sight in a corner has a magic mouth spell placed on it to speak to a dwarf: "Here's a kiss for you, runt!" Until it has spoken it will radiate magic very strongly.

6 beds, 7 chests, and two tables, 4 stools, and 4 chairs fill the room. Giant garments hang on pegs. A torch smolders at the west end; at the other end is an unlit torch.

  • Kelnam and the 3 stone giants (see Area 11) lodge here.

  • Unlit Torch. Kelnam’s sword @UUID[Item.HfqFEFl7BSwW94fp]{Avalanche} (see Items) disguised by an illusion (dispels on touch).

  • Beds. 4 bags tucked underneath contain a full skin of wine, 4 old sandals, and 3 small boulders.

  • Chests. Hold 5 small boulders, a crock pot, and soiled linens.
This place has 10 cots, 10 boxes, 4 stools, 1 table, 2 benches, and various odds and ends.

Same as Area 15, plus: A few cloaks hang from the wall and on a stool rests a small chest.

  • Chest. Holds dwarven & elven ears; one has an @UUID[Item.dIWZsaa0GewAeEIq]{earring} (10 gp)

Giant counters flank several central tables covered in cookware & food. A smelly chute sits in the north wall.

Dozens of cowering orcs in rags rush to deliver food and utensils to 5 giantesses dressed in aprons, who are busily preparing meals. 11 young ogres assist them.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{Giantesses}. Hill giants. Maids. Flee from threats crying “Help!” Bark orders at orcs; prepare meals for feast in Area 11.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.Rq4WF5z0ZBFHNLub]{Orcs}. Slaves. Flee from threats. Bring maids things demanded, take meals to Area 11 and return from there with dishes.

  • @UUID[Actor.mmvXjD6kgqMpmmXI]{Young Ogres}. 12 HP. Servants. Do menial tasks like chopping. Flee from threats crying “Help!”

  • Chute. Garbage is dropped down here to Area 56.

Stools and utensils crowd 3 tables. On one sits broken loaves of bread

Sacks and boxes emanate rich aromas of fruit and cheese. Humanoid limbs and questionable sausages hang from the rafters.

Several casks stand against a wall.

  • Orcs frequently take and deliver food from here to @UUID[.ZzZXYuozt0GfwEYP]{Area 17}.

  • Bread. Food for the maids and ogres in @UUID[.ZzZXYuozt0GfwEYP]{Area 17}.

  • Casks. Contain wine, beer & ale. Occasionally taken to @UUID[.5HzK03NeEXFwECVc]{Area 11}.

Boxes and casks frame a staircase descending into darkness.

  • Staircase. Leads to Area 26.

A large room is cluttered with cots, tables, stools, old clothing and junk. By the door hangs a heavy whip.

6 giantess maids coo and flirt with a flexing "handsome" giant warrior.

  • “Handsome” @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{Giant}. 43 HP. Dire wolf keeper (see Area 22). Does battle in order to show off for his admirers. Won’t cry for help unless brought to 22 HP.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{Maids}. Vying for giant’s attention. Flee if in danger.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.gear.Item.GgSheZNm2cOQYpZP]{Whip}. Belongs to “handsome” giant. Causes dire wolves in Area 22 to cower and retreat.

Palettes reeking of old sweat sit amongst piles of junk. 2 orcs lie in the mess, wincing.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.Rq4WF5z0ZBFHNLub]{Orcs}. Injured from giant kicks. Desperate to recover. Happily aid benevolent parties.

    • Know of the orc rebellion. Advise that orcs in Area 45 should be hailed as friends.

    • Otherwise, they know only of the great hall (@UUID[.5HzK03NeEXFwECVc]{Area 11}) and kitchen (Areas 17 & 18).

Large heaps of skins smell of unwashed bodies. At the far end sits a great iron chest.

Circled around a table littered with copper pieces are 5 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.VrYTiPjDOH1LIEBr]{ogres} drinking beer and throwing knuckle bones.

  • Skins. 22 heaps. Ogres’ beds. #15 hides a leather sack with 2 potions: @UUID[Item.5frfp8by2cGTmya1]{giant strength}, delusion (giant strength, see below).

  • Chest. Locked. Key held by the lead ogre (in Area 11). Contains 95 sp, 70 gp, and 8 pp,

  • Ogres. Rambunctious. Strongest one (34 HP) wears an @UUID[Item.uxTSjDOjhwTIk5F2]{emerald} (100 gp) on a thong around his neck.

  • Table. Has 38 cp as stakes for the game.

  • Noise from here attracts no attention whatsoever.

POTION OF DELUSION

Looks just like a potion you know…

Curse. This potion presents as another type. It passes novice visual and taste inspection.

When a creature drinks this, they are convinced they are under the effect of the presented potion, despite no effect occurring.

A large compound separates the Steading from a smaller structure. Roaming about are 14 monstrous dire wolves.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.fsxmTnmQ6ASZaVJ9]{Dire Wolves}. Howl. Attack any non-giant or non-ogre. Cower at sight of whip from @UUID[.63MtAVhE7gjbetrb]{Area 19}.

2 benches with stools line the walls. A sheaf of spears sits by the door. 7 giant shields and 4 clubs stand along the south wall. On a small central table rests a huge horn.

  • Horn. For calling dire wolves in Area 22.
A dozen beds and chests run the room. Junk is scattered over tables. Several broken weapons and dented helmets are strewn about.

Same as @UUID[.uZcAbWcZP0mg8otg]{Area 24}, plus: An alcove off to one side harbors a cot and 3 chests. On the wall hangs a sack.

  • Alcove. Belongs to the sergeant (feasting in @UUID[.5HzK03NeEXFwECVc]{Area 11}).

  • Cot. A sack underneath contains old helmets.

  • Chests. Filled with clothing and gear for troops and sergeant. At the bottom of one are 130 gp and 8 @UUID[Item.dR0ybZRM6wXdE6DR]{lapis lazuli} (10 gp each).

  • Sack. Contains giant boots.

FEATURES

Walls. Ancient, fine masonry.

Doors. Iron-bound planks.

Floors. Stone.

Ceilings. Arched and buttressed.

  • Passages: 10’ high at edges, 17’ high at center.

  • Small rooms: 20’ high

  • Large rooms: 30' high

Caves. Wet. Fungi. Stalagmites.

  • Caverns: 20’ high

  • Caves: 10’ high

ENCOUNTERS

  • Areas 26-33 & 50-54 are unsafe. +0 to encounter table result. @UUID[Macro.jLbZooR0iXTkH2X4]{Roll Dungeon Unsafe Enounter}

  • Areas 45-47 are unsafe. +2 to encounter table result. @UUID[Macro.cheiwuDkIruJEOZN]{Roll Dungeon Unsafe Enounter (+2)}

  • Areas 50-58 are unsafe. -2 to encounter table result. @UUID[Macro.3UZeEGDuMIjhLMe1]{Roll Dungeon Unsafe Encounter (-2)}

  • Area 49 is deadly. 2:6 chance of an encounter. +5 to encounter table result. @UUID[Macro.M5D3riFLuBJyqKSa]{Roll Dungeon Deadly Encounter (+5)}

Random Encounters

d4+x

Details

1

The Keeper (see Area 27) and pet snow ape out inspecting

2

4 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.VrYTiPjDOH1LIEBr]{ogres} seeking some orcs

3

A few smoky torches burn along the walls. Benches and tables are pushed out of the way, revealing a floor of blackish stone, much worn by the tread of countless feet.

  • Slaves are gathered here and sent to their tasks under guard.

  • Other dungeon crew revel here.

  • Secret door. Giant-sized. Eye holes 5’ and 15’ up. Loose stone hides a handle. Goes to Area 58. S

Skins coat the floor, covered by a bed, table, chair, 2 boxes, several crates and barrels, 1 chest and odds and ends of armor, weapons, furniture, tableware, and so forth.

  • Abode of The Keeper, a ghastly, hunched @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{hill giant}, twisted, and with but one good eye.

  • 2 pet @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.z4UPCFgmpXHwzmJu]{snow apes} lurk, one guarding north of the door, the other on a platform above it!

  • A loose stone in the floor hides: 540 gp, 5x 50 gp @UUID[Item.gg5u3h9JtOIisalt]{pearls}, 4x 10 gp @UUID[Item.Zgm8F62qb7IJP2uE]{turquoises}, and a large earthenware jug with 4 @UUID[Item.MBkFrzg7xT12cfPL]{Potions of Water Breathing}.

2 bugbears sit at a table before a hallway of prison cells. Keys hang from their belts. Near the door looms a brass gong.

  • Keys. Unlock cells i, ii, iii and v.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.qUuNdFtYmo1vXVP5]{Bugbears}. If able, strike gong to raise alarm. Otherwise, direct party to cell iv, wait for a distraction and then smite the gong and flee.

  • Cells. Contain the following:

    • i. Human merchant, insane.

    • ii. Human engineer, kept to help excavate dungeon.

    • iii. Leoldin the elf (use @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.BviPIbrJao1ubOX1]{Knight} with 35 HP) wounded from torture (14 HP) chained to wall. Freely serves lawful rescuer for 1 year.

    • iv. There is no key to this cell, but the lock can be picked or forced, DC 12. TRAP: 3 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.cWzG0yEVgIk8ijk6]{skeletons}; wear brass ring with glass gem. Bugbears claim to protect skeletons because they are magical. Skeletons attack with swords hidden by dust.

    • v. 5 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.Rq4WF5z0ZBFHNLub]{orc} rebels. 3 others were tortured and eaten. Eager to help anyone promising escape. Can lead party to Area 45 and vouch for them with rebel guards.

Crackling braziers light areas dressed in hides. Musky straw mounds and small crates line the

walls. Stools messily crowd tables littered with food scraps.

  • Straw mounds. Serve as beds.

  • Crates. Contain bugbears’ personal affects (worthless).

12 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.qUuNdFtYmo1vXVP5]{bugbears} stand at the ready.

  • Each has a spear and mace. They have 2d4 gp each.

12 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.qUuNdFtYmo1vXVP5]{bugbears} fast asleep.

  • Maces and spears are close at hand. Have 2d4 gp each.

12 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.qUuNdFtYmo1vXVP5]{bugbears} fast asleep.

  • Maces and spears are close at hand. Have 2d4 gp each.

5 bugbears drink ale at a crude table and discuss war. Bastard swords lean at their reach. One bugbear wears chain and towers above the others.

  • Bugbears. @UUID[Actor.P9YrMQ1IZuCjFbru]{Captain Kharr} (HP 24, AC 15 (chain)) and 4 @UUID[Actor.6zUi4v2yLuip8QXy]{lieutenants} (HP 19). Planning how to wipe out orcs in Area 45. Have 1d4x2 gp each. Kharr also has 3 @UUID[Item.pKeoVr40HC6VDBAA]{azurites} (10 gp each).
6 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.qUuNdFtYmo1vXVP5]{bugbears} readying for attack.

Doors with view holes and barred with a heavy iron rods close off 3 poorly lit chambers. Inside sitting on moldy straw and hard benches are wallowing orcs.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.Rq4WF5z0ZBFHNLub]{Orcs}. Unarmed, poor spirits. 24 in each area.

Barred gates with locked chains and bolts secure 3 unlit chambers.

Masses of smelly orcs with defiant eyes sit on scanty straw inside.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.qUuNdFtYmo1vXVP5]{Bugbears}. At positions marked "W" on map. Vigilant.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.Rq4WF5z0ZBFHNLub]{Orcs}. Unarmed, defiant spirits. There are 48, 24 and 16 in Areas 37, 38 and 39, respectively.

A central fire pit casts hellish light over an iron maiden, racks, whips and branding irons. Snores come from behind the rack to the north.

  • Snores. 2 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.sFz8XfLheORSuxxM]{hill giants} dozing. One has a @UUID[Item.DOJTyeuIYHqeqAoE]{gold chain} set with a fire opal (200 gp).

Racks of finished weapons line an east wing. Ahead precarious stacks of armaments block the way. Hammering echoes from beyond.

  • Racks. 19x pikes, 41x 6' spears, 16x battle axes, 9x two-handed swords, plus giant-sized items.

  • Stacks. Helmets balanced on shields, propped up by maces. If touched, fall with a clatter, alerting fire giants in Area 41C.

Incomplete arms lie on benches. 7 grim @UUID[Actor.SA0ZIiYQvWWDYXZg]{dwarves} in clinking shackles work on them.

  • Dwarves. Six wish only escape, but @UUID[Actor.X6k5CLhtD9ewFKpR]{Egrim} (use Orc Chieftain) serves rescuers for a loot share and a chance to fight giants.

  • Shackles. Armorer (Area 41C) has the keys.

Cast in the glow of forges are two @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.PzLMBzFtioZhBlTq]{fire giants} hammering metal. Keys hang from one’s belt.

  • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.PzLMBzFtioZhBlTq]{Fire giants}. Armorer (HP 51) and Smithy. Have 2x 400 gp @UUID[Item.t3hDb7DkS7QSEpzD]{rubies}.

  • Keys. For shackles in Area 41B.

A pile of stones blocks a moldering door with a heavy bronze bolt. A rancid odor leaks through its cracks.

  • Stones. Placed by fearful orcs.

  • Door. Beyond is putrid & dusty.

Icy masonry glows faintly with purplish green light. Murals stare out from the walls and columns, and shift when your back is turned.

Beyond an altar of translucent yellow stone stands before an alcove of purple glass.

  • Columns. Touch causes nausea.

  • Altar. Greasy to the touch.

  • Purple Glass. Gazing within close for one round causes a writhing form to emerge. 3:6 viewer goes insane, else touching it causes a @UUID[Item.Ldn0XUm4DHcZ3vHG]{Scarab of Insanity} to appear on the altar. A touch by a second viewer yields a giant ruby (500 gp).
Walls bearing traces of depraved murals flank a flight of steps that descend steeply to the south. Tons of rubble block the passage.

Crude camps stir with resolute @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.Rq4WF5z0ZBFHNLub]{orcs}.

  • Orcs. 78 rebel orc slaves, for whom the place is a sanctuary.

    • Armed with 7 crossbows, and cast-off weapons.

    • 3 leaders (@UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.v2Q2R3tGkcvslEbB]{orc chieftain}), 12 guards (8 HP) & 63 others.

    • Raid for food and gather fungus from sink hole cave.

    • Warily trade food to trogs (see Area 46) for water.

    • Own 45 cp, 23 sp & 19 gp.

    • Agreeable if party mentions fighting bugbears or giants.

Water flows through one corner. A small tribe of @UUID[Actor.kN2ZCr6ldu4u19Mp]{trogs} dwells here. The strongest wear gem amulets.

  • Water. Clear. Flows to Area 49.

  • Troglodytes. 33 @UUID[Actor.kN2ZCr6ldu4u19Mp]{adults} and 7 @UUID[Actor.ASbSkOJgxpp5HAy1]{young} (2 HP). Trapped between Areas 45 and 47; wish to escape.

  • Amulets. Trogs’ worship these. Leader has 4x 50 gp @UUID[Item.gg5u3h9JtOIisalt]{pearls}, others share 7x 10 gp @UUID[Item.1Z6kN4EDn5D7LBxN]{hematite} and 2x 5 gp @UUID[Item.vCuoa5xz7b4TLgzM]{agates}.

Broken bones litter the ground and the air smells of old blood.

  • Lizards lair here. Large & ancient (use @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.ZGILlry1pBhE4iDh]{triceratops}); 2 adults and 4 young (half HP).

    • Hunt trogs and orcs in caves below, entered via sinkhole.

A round chamber is filled with a deep pool of water.

  • Pool. Drinkable. 14’ deep; outlet at bottom large enough to swim through (goes to Area 49).

Piles of bones blanket this cavern. A babbling stream divides them.

  • 2 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.j7sQ6Km2jSx5twCC]{cave crawlers} in northeast.

  • Bones. 3 people can spend a round to search a 10’x10’ area. Use @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.rollable-tables.RollTable.Pi9nnnLeXpTKCSMY]{Treasure 0-3} table in core rules for what they find.

  • Stream. Emerges a mile south of Steading in a small pond.

    • Underwater hole in west side leads to Area 48. Upstream leads to Area 46.

Tools for digging and masonry are scattered about. A huge padlock hangs on the north door.

  • Padlock. Hard. Key carried by The Keeper (see Area 27).

  • Tools. Giant and human sized.

  • Ogres retreat to here from the upper level if it burns down.

The door to this room is padlocked.

Large barrels dominate the room. Each is sealed with a blob of black wax impressed with a death's head.

  • Padlock. Hard. Key carried by The Keeper (see Area 27).

  • Barrels. 13 total. Hold black wine; potent; earthy smell; unique taste.

    • 3:4 chance upon drinking to quaff until in a stupor.

    • Each holds 1d6 x 5 gallons. Gallon worth 1d3 x 80 gp.

    • Sent by giants’ masters, a gift to chief for his services.

Worked stone gives way to bare rock to the north. Tools for digging and masonry are scattered about.

  • Tools. Giant and human sized.

  • Giants retreat to here from the upper level if it burns down.

Piles of skins furnish the room.

Several chests and sacks are tucked under huge cots and tables.

  • 3 @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.zIaJgXifG1mIY7FM]{stone giants} stay here. Master miners for the dungeon. Lead by Kelnam (in Area 11).

  • Chests and sacks. Hold giants’ personal gear. Third chest has 1,423 gp.

A large empty chamber sits dark. Your light catches a glimmer west.

  • Glimmer. A pile of coffers along west wall spill over with riches.

    • Riches. Fake. Designed to lure invaders into a trap.

    • Touching chest causes bars (dotted lines) east to drop & south to raise (see Area 56).

    • Bars are reset by lever in Area 58.

• @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.monsters.Actor.LBjQecdHrFaX8SPj]{Manticores}. 4 total; enraged. Caged to guard treasure.

  • Chute. Garbage from Area 17 drops here to feed manticores.

  • Irons bars. South dotted line.

    • Close (can’t shoot through).

    • Raise when chest in Area 55 is touched or by lever in Area 58.

  • Falling bars. North dotted line.

    • Drop after manticores enter Area 55.

    • Wide (can shoot through).

    • Raised by lever in Area 58.

Chests and boxes fill the room.

  • Boxes. Empty.

  • Chests. 7 total. 1 empty, others:

    • 1. 1,300 cp

    • 2. 2,730 sp

      • Scything blade trap +5 to hit (2d6 damage), dismembers on a 20.

    • 3. 714 ep & @UUID[Item.x7HeQzeiTlbraE8X]{Potion of Poison}.

    • 4. 27 copper ingots worth 40 ep each

    • 5. 11x 100 gp @UUID[Item.aK20nahDLvVucrGO]{tusks}

    • 6. 10x 10 gp @UUID[Item.Zgm8F62qb7IJP2uE]{turquoises}

      • 2 Poison needle traps: In lock & false bottom (empty). Pass hard CON check or 4d6 damage.

Three levers hang on the west wall.

Pairs of holes sit high up on the north and east walls. A set match them at 5’ height.

  • Holes. Allow giants or humans to spy on Areas 26 or 54.

  • Levers. Each raises/lowers a set of bars in Areas 54 and 55.

A large chest, iron lock box and 2 small coffers sit in one corner. Opposite are 3 broken boxes and a broken barrel. Yellow mold covers the south west corner of the room.

  • Pit Trap. 2:4 chance trap door cover opens when walked on.

    • 10’ fall (1d6 damage);

    • 4 poisoned spikes at base. Pass Hard CON check or 3d6 damage.

  • Large Chest. 2,384 gp

  • Iron Box. Locked. 414 pp

  • Small Coffer A. 41x 10 gp @UUID[Item.vObpXh0qqDOJwMFa]{agates}, 13x 50 gp @UUID[Item.gg5u3h9JtOIisalt]{pearls} and 8x 100 gp @UUID[Item.uxTSjDOjhwTIk5F2]{emeralds}.

  • Small Coffer B. 17x 50 gp jewelry

  • Yellow Mold. Illusion hiding items hung upon the wall:

    • Quiver of +2 arrows (x11)

    • +3 Spear

    • 2 swords: @UUID[Item.d4XQk8LKExC46vn0]{Reclaimer} & @UUID[Item.tcHwsI03gmaAjGGt]{Redeemer} (see Items). Dislike each-other.

    • Broken Barrel. Illusion. Actually a cask holding a map of the Glacial Rift of the Frost Jarl (or another adventure site), an obsidian box that holds a @UUID[Item.L3baX6CtAlJPQfFF]{Chain of Passage} (see Items) attuned to that location, and the chain’s instructions written in giantish on human skin.

The giantess (hill giant) coming from Area 11 to get her pet bear
1 hill giant with 1d4 dire wolves from Area 22, going to Area 4
The chief (use frost giant) and 2 ogres fetching trophies from  Area 6 to show off in the Area 11
2d4 young giants (use ogre) from Area 3, heading through Area  22 to raid the pantry in Area 13
The giant chief Nosnra is a grossly fat and thoroughly despicable  creature. He is sly and vicious, loving ambush and backstabbing.
A band of dwarven smiths were taken captive by the giants, and now the giants wield finely crafted arms!
Beware! The giants employ bugbear trackers. Take care not to lead  them to your cave refuge.
Trust between the races of giants has always been tenuous. Their  alliance may be fragile.
Orcs have been seen serving the giants…and on their roasting pits!
An ancient dungeon lies beneath the Steading—a likely place to  keep prisoners.
